description: An anchors entry whose content_hash does not match the 'sha256:' + 64-lowercase-hex shape MUST be rejected with schema_violation — both at registry publish time and by a consumer validating a retrieved body. anchors[].content_hash uses the same acdp-common content_hash $def as the body's own content_hash field, so the same shape rule applies (RFC-ACDP-0016 §4).

expected.rationale: content_hash inside an anchor is not free-form — it is the acdp-common content_hash $def (RFC-ACDP-0001 §5.7 shape: 'sha256:' + 64 lowercase hex). A value failing that pattern fails schema validation at the same step any other malformed content_hash field would (contrast can-*, which pins the arithmetic case where the shape is valid but the digest doesn't match its preimage — this fixture pins the shape rejection itself).
